answer_1.quote: We study equity in text-generation in dialogue ... we test these theories on the GuessWhat?! game corpus. ... We focus on modelling the question-player and use an automated answer-player trained on human data.
answer_1.outputs: Generated questions and dialogues in the GuessWhat?! visual dialogue game

answer_4.quote: hum.eval. is % of model dialogues using gendered words correctly based on annotation (50 per method per annotator). Namely, two annotators were asked to determine correctness of gendered word use, evaluating both incorrect usage as well as false negatives; i.e., where use would be appropriate/helpful.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators determine correctness of gendered word usage in model dialogues.
